title: Technology Sector Update 07/11/2018: MSFT,HMNY,ERIC

Technology stocks were sinking in early-market trading.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
- Microsoft ( MSFT ) was down almost 1% in Wednesday's pre-market following reports the software and hardware giant is reducing its international sales force this week, laying off a small percentage of its workforce. The current reorganization is smaller than last year's layoffs, a source familiar with the matter told CNBC, adding the moves should not be considered a sign of Microsoft changing its strategy, which began its FY19 fiscal year last week.
In other sector news:
- Helios and Matheson Analytics Inc ( HMNY ) was slumping Wednesday morning, sliding over 6%, after launching a best-efforts public offering of its common stock and warrants. The number of shares and warrants to be sold, their price and other details of the underwritten offering will be disclosed at a later date. Net proceeds will be used to fund general corporate purposes at the company and its subsidiaries.
- Ericsson ( ERIC ) was over 1% lower in Wednesday's pre-market session, after the handset manufacturer announced an agreement to sell its Ericsson Local Services AB unit to Sweden-based Transtema Group AB. Terms of the deal were not disclosed. The local services business builds and maintains network infrastructure and delivers services in all areas of Sweden's field service operations market. The deal is expected to close in Q3, subject to regulatory approvals and other closing conditions.
